about.headline: Building rigorous analysis across the lab, markets, and publications.
paragraphs: I'm an undergraduate at NYU studying Math and Computer Science with a minor in Data Science. My work spans scanning electron microscopy research on 3D-printable glass nanoparticles, quantitative prep with the NYU Math Finance Group, and writing for the Data Science Society.

I'm drawn to problems that need both careful measurement and clear communication—whether that's presenting at ceramics and sol-gel conferences, modeling strategy in card games, or interviewing practitioners in data science.

bullets: Research on Scanning Electron Microscopy analysis of 3D-printable glass nanoparticles.
Analyzed data with Excel and Fiji; presented at All Iowa Glass conference (2023–2025).
Scheduled to present at the American Ceramics Society and International Sol-Gel Society conferences (2026).
Bookkeeping, accounting, and payroll timekeeping for 50+ employees and 200+ families.
Front-desk billing and enrollment; swim instruction for learners of varied ages.
Weekly market research readouts; quantitative and probability interview preparation.
Modeled markets mathematically, including probability and strategy in card games.
Monthly articles on data science topics for the society Medium publication.
Weekly interviews with data professionals; research on market trends and news.
Ran meetings, schedules, and workshops for 25+ students across engineering disciplines.
Guided multi-disciplinary projects and hands-on engineering problem solving.
